1. Quantitation by ²H ² O Standard Curve: 2. Standards are made from deuterium oxide (Aldrich 617385) 3. Pipette 10μl of plasma or standard into Eppendorf 4. ²H ² O standards a. Blank (MQ H ² O) b. 0.1% D ² O in (MQ H ² O) c. 0.5% D ² O in (MQ H ² O) d. 0.10% D ² O in (MQ H ² O) e. 1.5% D ² O in (MQ H ² O) f. 2.0% D ² O in (MQ H ² O) g. 2.5% D ² O in (MQ H ² O) h. 3.0% D ² O in (MQ H ² O) i. 3.5% D ² O in (MQ H ² O) j. 4.0% D ² O in (MQ H ² O) 5. Add 2μl of a 10N NaOH solution to each sample or standard 6. Add 4μl of acetone/acetonitrile solution (10μl of acetone +200μl of acetonitrile) to each sample 7. Be careful when taking samples out of the centrifuge to make sure that all of the drops are at the bottom of the tube 8. Cap and briefly centrifuge samples (~5sec) to ensure NaOH and acetonitrile react with sample 9. Let samples sit overnight (at least 10hrs) 10. Add 500μl of chloroform to samples 11. Add ~ 50mg Na 2 SO 4 salt to each sample 12. Centrifuge sample for 2 minutes 13. Pipette 100μl of chloroform layer into glass insert, place inserts in GC vials and cap, then assay on a GC-MS system, EI mode (see below for parameters and references).

steps.title: Prepare H2^18O standards
steps.instruction: Make a series of H₂¹⁸O standards in Milli‑Q water at the following concentrations: blank (0 %), 0.01 %, 0.05 %, 0.10 %, 0.15 %, 0.20 %, 0.25 %, 0.30 %, 0.35 %, and 0.40 % H₂¹⁸O.

steps.title: Aliquot sample or standard
steps.instruction: Pipette 5 µL of blood, plasma, or a prepared standard into a 12 × 75 mm glass tube.

steps.title: Generate phosphoric acid
steps.instruction: Add approximately 3 mg of PCl₅ to the tube, mix, and let stand for 20 minutes to convert water to phosphoric acid.

steps.title: Derivatize to TMP
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL of freshly prepared etheral‑diazomethane to the tube, let stand at room temperature until the ether evaporates; optionally add an additional 120 µL of diethyl ether in hexane to aid the reaction.

steps.title: Extract TMP
steps.instruction: Add 150 µL of water and 600 µL of chloroform (1 : 4 v/v) to the tube, then add 0.5 g of Na₂SO₄.

steps.title: Transfer organic layer
steps.instruction: Vigorously mix the tube, then transfer a small aliquot of the chloroform layer to a GC‑MS vial for analysis.

steps.title: GC‑MS analysis setup
steps.instruction: Analyze acetone and TMP derivatives on an Agilent 5973N‑MSD coupled to an Agilent 6890 GC equipped with a DB‑17MS capillary column (30 m × 0.25 mm × 0.25 µm) operating in electron‑impact mode at 70 eV.

steps.title: Monitor ions and calculate enrichments
steps.instruction: Use selective ion monitoring: m/z 58 and 59 for acetone (²H) and m/z 140 and 142 for TMP (¹⁸O). Calculate ²H enrichment from the ²H‑H₂O standard curve; calculate ¹⁸O enrichment from the ratio 142 / (142 + 140).
